No. 972
Date ....................

April 13,

Sir Everard J.H. Fraser, K.C.M.G.,
H.B.M's Consul-General,
Shanghai.

My dear Sir Everard, Confidential.

In the beginning of March the
Japanese Police Magistrate at Shanghai received
information from a Japanese woman, of middle age,
named Kanegoto, to the effect that she had been
approached by certain Chinese members of the Kohming-
tang, supposed to be acting under German influence,
who had asked her if she would carry a bomb in a
parcel done up to resemble a baby on board and leave
it in the cabin of a certain steamer which was not
specified, but which was supposed to leave Shanghai
carrying Chinese coolies to some place abroad.

The woman was promised a sum of money to do this.
She was instructed to continue negotiations
with the Chinese and to demand payment of one half
of the amount in advance which, if she received,
she was to bring to the Consulate as proof of the
veracity of her story.

Certain arrangements were made by the C.I.D.
to effect arrests as soon as this had been carried
out, but later information from the same woman
indicated that the plan of placing bombs on board
ships had been abandoned entirely.

第 972 号
日期 ....................

1917年4月13日，

埃弗拉德·J.H. 弗雷泽爵士，K.C.M.G.，
英国驻上海总领事，
上海。

亲爱的弗雷泽爵士，机密。

三月初，上海日本警察署长从一名中年日本妇女后藤金 (Kanegoto) 处获得情报，称有若干国民党华人成员接近她，据信这些人是在德国人的指使下行动。这些人询问她是否愿意将一个包裹带上船，该包裹被伪装成婴儿的样子，并将其留在某艘轮船的客舱内。该轮船的具体名称未指明，但据称将离开上海，载运中国苦力前往海外某地。

该妇女被告知，若以此行事，将获得一笔金钱报酬。
她受指示继续与这些华人进行谈判，并要求预先支付一半的金额；如果她收到这笔钱，应将其带到领事馆，作为其所述情况属实的证明。

刑事侦缉处已做出某些安排，以便在上述行动实施后立即进行逮捕，但随后从同一妇女处获得的情报表明，在船上放置炸弹的计划已被完全放弃。

然而，她表示还有另一项阴谋正在酝酿中，其性质她并不

Her husband, who is a Chinese and who belongs

Hsia Kwan (下关 ) at Nanking and that he is in

I suggest that perhaps it would be advisable to

are keeping closely in touch with the affair.

Yours sincerely,

Captain-Superintendent of Police.

她的丈夫是华人，属于前革命党人，可能是此事的主要策划者之一。她提供其姓名为甘白 (Kan Pah)，并称他居住在南京下关 (Hsia Kwan)，受雇于扬州的盐务稽核所 (Salt Gabelle)。
我建议，或许宜就此人通知英国驻南京领事。与此同时，日本当局正与此事保持密切联系。

Form 2    36
Shanghai Municipal Police.    972
Hongkew    Station.
April 11th    1917
REPORT ON    alleged German Consul Chinese agents.
Made by    D.S.I.Reeves.    Forwarded by    Chief Detective Inspector

Sir,
It will be remembered that on the 22nd February 1917, a bomb explosion took place on the Morrison Road, and within 10 minutes of the occurrence I arrested a Japanese named Noboru Yamada together with two Chinese near the scene of the explosion. Apart from the fact that the two Chinese were revolutionaries, no proof against them for being concerned in the explosion could be obtained, and they were released on security. The Japanese was sentenced to 15 days and to be deported as an undesirable. Whilst this Japanese was in custody at the Japanese Consulate a Japanese woman named Kane - Goto went to the Japanese Police Magistrate and made a voluntary statement to the effect that her husband was a Chinese, and that she had been approached by certain Chinese who were friends of her husband and who were employed as German Consul agents in Shanghai, to place certain bombs on Allied Steamers which would leave ports in China. She went as far as to divulge the information as to how she was to get the bombs on the steamers, that is, she was to carry a baby with the bombs and in this way to prevent suspicion. This woman's story was in a good many respects believed and the information was conveyed to me which I conveyed verbally to you, and arrangements were made to be on call at any moment the Japanese authorities called for our assistance. This was kept up for some time and nothing happened and then the Japanese Police Authorities discovered that the man Noboru Yamada arrested in connection with the Morrison Road bomb explosion was a sweetheart of

虹口    巡捕房。
1917年4月11日
关于    涉嫌德国领事馆华籍特工的报告。
由    副督察里夫斯 (D.S.I. Reeves) 制作。    由    首席督察转发

先生，
谨忆及1917年2月22日，莫利哀路 (Morrison Road) 发生了一起炸弹爆炸事件，事发后10分钟内，我在爆炸现场附近逮捕了一名名叫山田升 (Noboru Yamada) 的日本人和两名华人。除了这两名华人是革命党人这一事实外，无法获得任何证明他们参与爆炸的证据，他们在提供担保后被释放。该日本人被判处15天监禁，并作为不受欢迎的人被驱逐出境。当这名日本人在日本领事馆拘留期间，一名名叫后藤金 (Kane - Goto) 的日本妇女前往日本警察署长处，自愿作出陈述，称其丈夫是华人，且有一些华人与其丈夫是朋友，这些人在上海受雇为德国领事馆的特工，他们接近她，要求她在即将离开中国港口的盟国轮船上放置某些炸弹。她甚至透露了如何将炸弹带上轮船的信息，即她将携带一个藏有炸弹的婴儿，以此避免怀疑。在许多方面，人们相信这名妇女的故事，并将此情报传达给我，我随即口头转达给您，并做出安排，以便在日本当局需要协助时随时待命。这种情况持续了一段时间，但未发生任何事情，随后日本警察当局发现，因莫利哀路炸弹爆炸案而被捕的山田升是

she was making these reports to get a favour from the Magis-
trate not to deport Yamada.    Yamada however was sent to
Japan and after an interval of another week and nothing further
was received from this woman the Police Magistrate had another
interview with the woman, who reported to him that the original
plan of placing bombs on board ships had fallen through as the
Chinese said that if an explosion took place a great number of
their own countrymen would perish.    The Japanese Authorities at
this stage did not know what to think of the matter and were in-
clined to think that the woman's story had no foundation, but at
the same time were not altogether satisfied that there was not
something in the woman's information.    She was evidently unable
to state who these Chinese were or give the place where they lived.
    In a later interview the Japanese Authorities had with this
woman, she stated again that the bombing of steamers had been
abandoned, but the German Chinese Agents were still contemplating
to carry out some scheme to which she probably would be a party.
She gave the name of her husband as Khoen Bah (甘白) and
stated that he was employed in the Salt Gabelle at Yang-Chow
and his residence was in Asia House, Hyer Kwong at Nanking and was a support-
er of Fung Chung Kang Koh Ching the vice President.

I am Sir,
Your obedient servant.
Percy A. Reeves
D.S.I.

Chief Detective Inspector.

上海公共租界警务处。    972
巡捕房。
191

报告关于

由                转发由

她向署长做这些报告是为了求得恩惠，以免山田被驱逐出境。然而，山田被送往日本，此后又过了一周，未从该妇女处收到进一步消息，警察署长再次与该妇女会面，她向他报告说，最初在船上放置炸弹的计划已告失败，因为那些华人表示，如果发生爆炸，许多他们的同胞将会丧生。此时，日本当局不知如何看待此事，倾向于认为该妇女的故事毫无根据，但同时也并不完全确信该妇女的情报中没有任何实质内容。她显然无法说明这些华人是谁，也无法提供他们的居住地。
在日本当局与该妇女的后续会面中，她再次声明，轰炸轮船的计划已被放弃，但德籍华人工仍在酝酿执行某项阴谋，而她很可能参与其中。她提供其丈夫姓名为甘白 (Khoen Bah)，并称他受雇于扬州的盐务稽核所 (Salt Gabelle)，其住所位于南京霞光 (Hyer Kwong，音译) 的亚细亚公寓 (Asia House)，并且是副总统冯国璋 (Fung Chung Kang Koh Ching，音译) 的支持者。

先生，
您顺从的仆人。
珀西·A·里夫斯 (Percy A. Reeves)
副督察。

首席督察。

Date 3/3/17.

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

March 2nd 1917.

Sir,

Information has been received to the effect
that an attempt will be made to place a bomb
on board a steamer sailing from Shanghai.

The time has not been specified and the
name of the steamer is not yet known. The
scheme is to be arranged by some members of
the ex-revolutionary party who are familiar
with the handling of explosives.

Your Obedient Servant,

[签名]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

R.H.
3/3/17.

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1917年3月2日。

先生，

收到情报称，有人企图在从上海启航的一艘轮船上放置炸弹。

具体时间未指明，轮船名称也尚不清楚。该阴谋由一些熟悉炸药操作的前革命党成员策划。

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]

首席督察。

警务处处长。

R.H.
1917年3月3日。
